notes.title: 🎨 New Look, Smoother Gameplay — Caramel Creek Update!
notes.content:
🌟 Caramel Creek has just become even cozier! 🌟

Hey everyone! We’ve just rolled out a big update, and here’s what’s new:

🎨 The entire visual style has been redrawn — now brighter, richer, and full of warmth. Every frame looks like a page from a cozy storybook.

🗺️ The main location map has been redesigned to feel more open and natural. The town layout makes more sense, planting zones are more accessible, and there's a stronger visual flow between areas.

🤖 Major fixes for NPC pathfinding — characters now move smoother, avoid obstacles better, and help the world feel alive.

🧡 Want to support development and get sneak peeks behind the scenes?  
Take a look here: patreon.com/BirukApps

Thank you for being a part of this journey.  
Stay warm, and see you in Caramel Creek!
